Choose one enemy within 5 squares that can hear you. One willing ally within 5 squares that can see or hear you. The spirit calls out in the target’s own voice from a point you choose within 5 squares. The target turns toward the voice. The ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking and gains 1 Boon to its next attack against that target before the start of your next turn.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One enemy within 5 squares that can hear you; one willing ally within 5 squares that can see or hear you.
Duration
Movement is immediate; the Boon expires when used or at the start of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once on your turn.
Type
Signature

The spirit calls out in the target’s own voice from a point you choose within 5 squares. The target turns toward the voice. The ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking and gains 1 Boon to its next attack against that target before the start of your next turn.
